_comment: app_box runtime config — bundled with the app (R3: no literals in code). The repo-level config/app-box.config.json is the pipeline's SSOT for targets/kit SHA; this file holds app-side runtime values. Kit wired/stubbed state is encoded in KitInventoryService from docs/research/stub-inventory.md (the SSOT), not here.

pipeline._comment: 8.8 — the app shells OUT to the vendored pipeline via this command. The runner resolves the binary; if absent it reports not-available (honest, never fakes green). Vendored by plan 03 into pipeline/pipeline.sh.

harness._comment: 8.10 — an already-authenticated harness CLI, when present. The app shells out to it for subscription auth rather than holding OAuth tokens itself (standalone-only path uses OAuth).

mcp._comment: 8.9 — MCP servers the chat surface connects to. Both transports supported: stdio (local, desktop-optimal) and Streamable HTTP+SSE (remote, bearer/API keys). Tools from all servers combine into one registry.

launch._comment: 8.13 / J1 — auto-launch the showcase app on first install so Michelle sees output quality before typing anything.

licence._comment: 8.12 — licence check is a PRECONDITION (runs before builder), not a gate. Nothing goes red for money.
licence.preconditionMessage: A valid app_box licence is required to build. Add a licence in Settings → Credentials.

prototype._comment: 09 — the embedded prototype server. 'runtime' selects the engine: 'embedded' (Dart HttpServer + flutter_js / JavaScriptCore, no Node on PATH) or 'node' (dev-only, spawns the designer's serve.mjs for byte-for-byte comparison). host/port match prototypeServer in the repo-level config.
